description: Source code implementing test SSL private key classes and functions for handling SSL private keys, including signing and wrapping OpenSSL private keys, within the Chromium project.

classes.name: TestSSLPlatformKey
classes.description: A delegate class for handling SSL private key operations, including signing, using a provided EVP_PKEY.

classes.name: FailingSSLPlatformKey
classes.description: A delegate class that simulates failure in SSL private key signing operations.

methods.name: WrapOpenSSLPrivateKey
methods.description: Wraps an EVP_PKEY into a ThreadedSSLPrivateKey object.

methods.name: WrapRSAPrivateKey
methods.description: Wraps an RSA private key into an SSLPrivateKey object.

methods.name: CreateFailSigningSSLPrivateKey
methods.description: Creates an SSLPrivateKey that always fails to sign.
